title: A fee the gym asked a member to pay quietly disappears from the member app after 7 days, though it is still owed
what: When the desk asks a member to pay a fee and the gym has a payment company connected, the online payment link runs out after 7 days. From then on the member app's list leaves the fee out completely, because it only shows asks that are still open or paid. A fee asked more than 30 days ago is also left out, even one that never runs out. The app has words ready for this case (This payment link has run out. Ask the desk for a new one.) but they never reach the My membership card. The member sees nothing owed and may think the fee is settled.
expected: A fee the member still owes stays on My membership, with a plain line that the payment link ran out and the desk can send a new one.
who: members of gyms that ask for fees in the app
how_often: every fee not paid within 7 days of the ask
fix_line: Keep run-out fee asks in the member's list and show the ready-made run-out words

title: Renew my plan asks the member to pick a plan without showing what any plan costs
what: The Renew my plan list shows each plan's name and length only. The server never sends a price, and the app is written to never show one, on the old reason that the member's number is not checked. The plan prices are the gym's own list, not the member's private data, and the same card already shows the member's dues in rupees when the gym takes payments in the app. A member sends a renewal for a plan without knowing what the desk will charge.
expected: Each plan in the renew list shows its price, so the member knows what they agree to before sending the request.
who: members who renew from the app
fix_line: Send and show each plan's price in the renew list

title: Renewal and plan-ending words always say pay at the desk, also at gyms that take payments in the member app
what: The renew help says you pay at the desk, an approved renewal says Pay at the desk if you have not yet, and the plan-ending card and Workout tab card say Renew at the desk or front desk. None of these look at the gym's switch for taking payments in the member app. At a gym with that switch on, the same My membership card can show a Pay your gym box with UPI and online buttons right next to words telling the member to pay at the desk.
expected: When the gym takes payments in the app, these lines say the member can pay in the app or at the desk.
who: members of gyms that take payments in the app
how_often: every renewal and plan-ending card at those gyms
fix_line: Pick the pay words from the gym's in-app payment switch

items.reason: Read every money file in the area: shop prices and totals (whole paise, Indian grouping), fee and shop pay asks, renew list, membership and plan-ending cards, Plus lock read. Shop totals are re-priced by the server and the bag says when the gym charged another total. New: renew list shows no prices (FN-L5-phone-shop-2-02) and pay-at-desk words ignore the in-app pay switch (FN-L5-phone-shop-2-03). No GST, receipt, trial or credits wording lives in these files; members never pay MettleUp (refund page).

The app reads testMode for each pay ask, but the paid line (Paid, thank you / Paid. The gym can see it.) ignores it, while the gym records nothing for a test payment. Same fault as FN-L5-server-panel-worker-01, reused.

Failed: the try-again line shows. Expired: the fee drops off the member list with no word (FN-L5-phone-shop-2-01). Cancelled: an order the member already paid online can be cancelled by the member, also in bulk when they leave or switch gyms, with no refund word; same fault as FN-L5-panel-shop-02, reused. Refunded at the payment company after it was paid: the app keeps saying Paid; same root as FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-06, reused. Pending UPI app or QR payments: the app says the gym saves the receipt after you pay.

Fee amount and label shown to the member are the desk's own ask (paise, same UPI link format as the admin app); a shop payment takes the order total from the gym's server, and a changed total cancels the old link first. No mismatch found inside this area; panel and HQ amounts belong to other helpers.
